question: Callie sorted her beads into 100 piles.  The first pile had 1 bead;  the second pile had 3 beads;  the third pile had 5 beads, and so on.  Stacy sorted her beads into 100 piles, each containing an equal number of beads.  If both girls have the smame number of beads, how many beads did Stacy put in each pile?
